signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Quarterbacks with generational arms have the power to stretch any defense to its breaking point. When they enter the zone, their maximum throw distance is increased by 15+ yards.
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws under 40 yards while running outside the pocket (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all unpressured throws inside the red zone (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have increased throw power on bullet precision passes (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all cross-body throws up to 20 yards (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have access to four extra hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Zone Hawk defenders lock down a part of the field. When they enter the zone, this ability increases the rate of interceptions while in zone coverage.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone
Players with this ability have an increased chance to catch passes that have been tipped into the air.
The best physical receivers don't just come down with the ball, they carry it home. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed to break their first post-catch tackle.
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Ballcarriers with this ability will frequently attempt to gain extra yards while being tackled
Defenders with this ability will grant a bonus pass rush point to all defensive linemen on any 3rd or 4th down
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
